correctness.rationale: Strong induction on n shows s(n+2)=(2 nu_2(n+1)+1)s(n+1)-s(n) exactly. L(x,y)=(x,x+y), R(x,y)=(x+y,y) act by invertible permutations of all J_2(m) primitive consecutive-pair residues. Strong connectivity from coprime positive Stern/Calkin–Wilf enumeration plus finite permutation reversibility and a self-loop yields irreducible aperiodic Markov mixing to uniform primitive pair. A terminal binary suffix 0 1^t has density 2^(-(t+1)), independent asymptotically of the pair state after freely varying earlier digits; dyadic aligned intervals extend to ordinary natural density. Solving 2bt ≡ a+c-b (mod m) gives q=m/gcd(2b,m), and a single residue class t=r mod q with geometric mass [1/J_2(m)]2^(-(r+1))/(1-2^-q), with q=1 and m composite included. Independently checked exact normalized modular triple mass tables for m=2..12, partial empirical n<65536 distributions and Stern identity; no claim of uniform-in-m mixing rate.
